title: Feature extraction and categorization are not the correlate of seeing

statements.text: Feature extraction, categorization and some perceptual interference and inference occur whether or not a stimulus is seen, so they are excluded from the neural correlate of conscious seeing. Face-selective cells signal the category face without that being the same as seeing a face.

sources.quote: feature extraction, categorization, some interference and inference occur regardless of whether one is conscious of the visual stimulus or not
this is by no means similar to consciously seeing a face
